  {"step": 2, "file": "src/range.c", "function": "range_num_to_a", "line": 384, "var": "end", "code": "if (mrb_float_p(end))", "note": "The end value is a Float, so the integer-float branch is entered."},
  {"step": 3, "file": "src/range.c", "function": "range_num_to_a", "line": 385, "var": "a", "code": "mrb_float a = (mrb_float)mrb_integer(beg);", "note": "Integer 9007199254740993 is converted to double, losing precision and rounding down to 9007199254740992.0 (2^53)."},
  {"step": 4, "file": "src/range.c", "function": "range_num_to_a", "line": 386, "var": "b", "code": "mrb_float b = mrb_float(end);", "note": "Float end 9007199254741000.0 is stored as double b."},
  {"step": 5, "file": "src/range.c", "function": "range_num_to_a", "line": 391, "var": "ary", "code": "ary = mrb_ary_new_capa(mrb, (mrb_int)(b - a) + 1);", "note": "Capacity computed as (mrb_int)(8.0) + 1 = 9, allocating a 72-byte heap buffer for 9 mrb_value slots."},
  {"step": 6, "file": "src/range.c", "function": "range_num_to_a", "line": 402, "var": "a", "code": "while (a <= b)", "note": "Loop condition compares float a (9007199254740992.0) against b (9007199254741000.0); since a <= b is true, the loop body executes."},
  {"step": 7, "file": "src/range.c", "function": "range_num_to_a", "line": 403, "var": "ptr[i]", "code": "ptr[i++] = mrb_int_value(mrb, (mrb_int)a);", "note": "Writes mrb_value to ptr[i]. Because a += 1.0 at line 405 does not change a (9007199254740992.0 + 1.0 rounds back to 9007199254740992.0 since 2^53+1 is not representable as double), the loop never terminates and writes past the 9-element heap buffer, causing heap-buffer-overflow."},
  {"step": 8, "file": "src/range.c", "function": "range_num_to_a", "line": 403, "var": "ptr[9]", "code": "ptr[i++] = mrb_int_value(mrb, (mrb_int)a);", "note": "When i reaches 9, the write goes 0 bytes past the 72-byte allocation, triggering AddressSanitizer heap-buffer-overflow (WRITE of size 8)."}
]
EOF
cat /workspace/candidate_trace.json
